title: Sughra Na Ji Payegi
body:
Aye mere baba sughra na ji payegi.
Is tarha tanha sughra na ji payegi.
.
Aye na jab pardes se sarwar
Sughra ye khat likhti hai tarpkar
Puch rahi hai baba ye dukhtar.
Aaye nhi pardes se kyu kar
Samjho khudara sughra na ji payegi
.
Pathta hai dil ye soch ke mera
Koi nhi hai mera sahra
Socho agar mai mar gai baba.
Kese uthega mera janaza.
Dil hai ye kehta sughra na ji payegi.
.
Baba tumhe kya haal sunau.
Hal mai dil ka kese dikhau.
Kese tumhe mai paas bulau
Soch ke din bhar ashk bahau.
Haal hai aisa sughra na ji payegi
.
Shadi jo tum akbar ki rachana
Baba mujhe tum bhul na jana
Hun mai Boht beemar ye mana.
Phir bhi mujhe shadi me bulana
Baba ye warna sughra na ji payegi
.
Wada jo tum ne mujh se kiya tha.
Jald tumhe bulvaunga sughra
Mai to abhi tak takti hu rasta.
Koi bhi mujh ko lene na aaya
Lagta hai asa sughra na ji payegi
.
Kese batau apni mai halat.
Mujh pe har ak lamha hai qayamt
Kese sahu mai ap ki furqat
Ye mera khat hai meri wasiyat
Hai waqt aya sughra na ji payegi
.
Mai hoon Bahout naraz aye baba.
Beti ko apni tum ne hai chhora.
Taqti hu ab tak uska me rasta
Tum ne ali akbar ko na bheja
Akbar se kehna sughra na ji payegi
.
Usne larzte hatho se JOHAR
Khat me kiya Mahfooz wo Manzar
Baba agar naa aaye palatkar
Zinda nhi mil payegi dukhtar
Baba aye baba sughra na ji payegi
author: Mir Johar Shikarpuri
